# Category Service

## Purpose
The Category Service provides a generalized mechanism for classifying and grouping any entity within the system. It supports creating categories that can be associated with various objects to facilitate filtering, reporting, and organizational logic.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Category** | `/plugins/Category/getAllCategories` | POST | Lists all categories. |
| **Category** | `/plugins/Category/createCategory` | POST | Creates a new category. |
| **CategoryToBaseclass** | `/plugins/CategoryToBaseclass/getAllCategoryToBaseclass` | POST | Lists links between categories and entities. |
| **CategoryToClazz** | `/plugins/CategoryToClazz/getAllCategoryToClazz` | POST | Lists links between categories and classes. |

## Dependencies
- **category-model**: Core data structures for categorization.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Generic Categorization**: Can be applied to ANY entity in the system by using `CategoryToBaseclass`.
- **Class-Level Categories**: Categories can be applied to entire types of objects (Clazz).

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as CategoryController
    participant Service as CategoryService
    participant Repository as CategoryRepository

    User->>Controller: createCategory(CategoryCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createCategory(CategoryCreate)
    Service->>Repository: merge(Category)
    Repository-->>User: Category Created
```
